note: Hidden mechanics as data, so 'did the agent find it' is a query, never a reading exercise. Every rule has a probe in probes/ that the test suite executes; a rule whose probe fails is a dead entry.

rules.name: throw_inherits_body_velocity
rules.observable: A block released mid-jump peaks noticeably higher than the same throw from the ground.
rules.provenance: Discovered by 6 of 13 agents in the source experiment; its designers did not know the simulator allowed it.

rules.name: rock_impact_spawns_cubes
rules.observable: ImpactBlock entities appear after the rock lands hard.
rules.provenance: Deliberate in the source experiment; 12 of 13 agents discovered it.

rules.name: ring_can_be_worn_at_spawn
rules.observable: Placing the ring at the spawn point and stepping out of bounds respawns the body inside the ring's hole.
rules.provenance: Emergent in the source experiment: no code intended it. Kept because it is a genuine example of a mechanic nobody wrote.

rules.name: adjacent_cubes_transmit_push_on_incline
rules.observable: Two cubes set close together on a slope push each other up to a threshold angle, then stop.
rules.provenance: New in this project. No external affordance: discoverable only by experiment.

rules.name: high_landing_retains_bounce
rules.observable: An object thrown onto a mesa above height 12 keeps a small residual bounce; the same object on the ground does not.
rules.provenance: New in this project. Tests whether agents notice that physics varies by location.
